target: 50% net wins is interim research, original project goal unchanged

candidates.hypothesis: A first 30-minute noise estimate is too small relative to costs. Observe the first two hours, enter only a subsequent break of that fixed range, and place the stop beyond its opposite boundary.

Chasing excursions may lose in mean-reverting sessions. After a post-range outside mark, enter only on a later mark back inside the fixed range, in the opposite direction, with the stop at the failed excursion.

fixed.exits: existing targets and original-R trail; research window close at four hours
fixed.cost_gate: C < initial stop distance; refuse that mark, not the whole session; this is part of each new candidate, not promotion of failed v2
fixed.range_definition: midpoints of first fresh quote within five seconds of minutes30/60/90/120; not intrabar high/low

reuse_warning: 6–10 October baseline M30 studies and 6 October tick admission already inspected; validation is frozen development validation, not pristine holdout
stopping: No retuning on validation. Both candidates and all losses retained. Failure or insufficient evidence must not be called 50% achieved. Tick-qualified validation required before any strategy promotion.
budget: Two candidates, one baseline, one development/validation cycle; investigate findings before another registered cycle. No live rule/risk change.
data_efficiency: Candidates fetch ticks only; baseline bars fetched once per symbol and attached offline with original input hashes retained.
